inspectedFrames.note: Original frame bytes/provenance retained unchanged. Final candidate reran all real 4K/control and advanced 320px/390px assertions successfully. No current-frame inspection claim is inferred from the run alone.

publicSmoke.result: Published Binary Flash opened from the public catalog. Actual controls sent 1001/parity0, then 0111/parity1 using two serial clocks: 2/2 frames, 9 operations, 0 rejected. Commissioned/save feedback appeared; reload displayed Mission 2 and 1 packet commissioned.
publicSmoke.environment: Cloud browser with WebGL 2 explicitly unavailable; this is public command/progression/persistence smoke evidence, not rendering evidence.

limitations: Ubuntu 24.04 CI Chromium/SwiftShader evidence; hardware FPS/load and physical touch/gamepad are not qualified.
Automated axe/reflow/focus checks do not replace full assistive-technology play.
Live AI still requires actual API/provider/judge deployment and configuration; test fixtures are not live competition.
The original 2,000-title, complete Bible, complete localization and native-console scope remains unfinished.
